title: Tacos & Tech (Neal Bloom) releases Eric's SDSU Angel Conference fireside as a podcast episode
summary: Neal Bloom — co-host of the Tacos & Tech Podcast and San Diego VC — releases Eric's on-stage fireside from the SDSU San Diego Angel Conference as a standalone podcast episode.
blockquote: This week on the Tacos & Tech Podcast, Eric Ries… takes the stage at the SDSU San Diego Angel Conference for a fireside on his new book, Incorruptible. Why do great companies get worse as they get bigger? And what keeps the rare ones honest?
attribution_title: Co-host, Tacos & Tech Podcast; San Diego venture capital
